pattern: というところだ / といったところだ
aliases: to iu tokoro da / to itta tokoro da
purpose: Give a rough estimate or characterize a result as modest.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express feelings speak politely show respect
Quantity / description + というところだ / といったところだ
It is roughly seventy percent complete.
It is about a fifteen-minute walk.
formation: Quantity / description + というところだ / といったところだ
restrictions: Often sets an approximate level or upper limit.
mistake: It is a loose assessment, not an exact measurement.
